//: What breaks off a character's long wait or its plan (03 §5.3): the engine decides none of it. A character someone plays, waiting an hour or walking a long way, stops and is asked what it does when it comes to see someone it holds a foe or fears (by sight: footsteps of a foe moving about out of sight do not break a wait), or when it is hurt. Its own mind's stances say who is a foe, so this reads only what the character believes. A mod switches these off with the setting `core:interrupts`.
doc: Breaking off the waits and plans of the characters a player plays when a foe comes into sight or they are hurt. On unless the setting `core:interrupts` is false.

if: event.percept == 'detection' and event.signal == 'core:sight' and self.control == 'direct' and not is_null(about) and (self.hostile(about) or self.fears(about))
doc: A character someone plays who comes to see a foe stops waiting, or stops what it planned, and is asked.
A character someone plays who is wounded stops waiting, or stops what it planned, and is asked.
